skill_name: Compare and contrast a monopoly and an oligopoly.
workflow: A monopoly is a market structure where there is only one seller of a good or service. An oligopoly is a market structure where there are only a few sellers of a good or service. In a monopoly, the one seller has complete and total control over the market and can set prices and output quantity. In an oligopoly, the few sellers have some control over the market, but competition between them keeps prices at a lower level and can shape output quantities.
